propositions: Ticket descriptions exceeding 8,000 characters must be blocked at plan-review and completion-verification gates before any LLM call or context assembly.
Plan review returns deterministic BLOCK with coverage.llm_ran=false; completion verification returns validated deterministic FAIL with zero runner calls when description exceeds the maximum.
Light-bug-tier plan review must partition DET blocks to retain only blocking P4 description findings while downgrading other DET blocks to advisory.
AC-count and file-impact P4 signals remain advisory; only oversized description makes P4 result blocking.
The default maximum description length is configurable via typed [verify] setting with default 8,000 characters; exactly 8,000 is admitted, 8,001+ is blocked.
